description: Get one Signal8 Academy guide as Markdown, by track and slug (both come from search_learn_guides, or from a signal8.ai/learn/<track>/<slug> URL). Returns title, description, section, lastVerified, the public url, the full Markdown body (links already rewritten to absolute signal8.ai URLs), the related guides, the glossary terms it uses (with one-line definitions) and its SEC sources (accession numbers). Guides use hypothetical examples ("Company X") unless a source is cited; they are education, not advice about any named company. When you quote or paraphrase a guide, cite its url. Works without an API key.

track.description: Academy track: "dilution" (dilution & toxic financing), "filings" (reading SEC filings), "market-structure" (halts, short interest, float, splits, congressional trading), or "signal8" (using Signal8, its API and this MCP server).
